name: account for an absence
description: Said when someone who should be here has not been, and the asking has teeth.

name: ask what is inside
description: Said to make the closed thing — box, room, mouth — declare itself.

name: press for a decision
description: Said when patience has run out and the answer must be dated.

name: admit the struggle
description: Said when the difficulty is finally named out loud, and meant.

name: ask the way
description: Said to get bearings — on roads, and on where this whole thing is going.

name: reassure that it is fine
description: Said to put a small mercy between someone and their worry.

name: get a thing working
description: Said with sleeves going up and expectations going down.

name: say what matters
description: Said to cut the sentence down to the one clause that carries weight.

name: offer your eyes
description: Said by someone who can read, to someone who cannot.

name: conclude someone is gone
description: Said when the empty chair has made its argument and won.

name: approach a house
description: Said at a threshold, wondering who is home and whether to knock.

name: cite the rule
description: Said when the way out is printed somewhere and someone must read it.

name: confirm formally
description: Said to close a matter with the correct words and a small bow.

name: remember the plenty
description: Said to hold onto how much there was before counting what is left.
